projects.title: Creation and Integration of AR/VR Modules to enhance Employee skills in Manufacturing Operations for India and Morocco
projects.summary: Real welding equipment, calibrated industrial sensors and multilingual VR modules for repeatable operator training.
projects.overview: At Tata Advanced Systems, Land Mobility Division, I worked on the creation and integration of AR/VR training modules for manufacturing operations in India and Morocco. The work connected industrial equipment, virtual simulations and operator feedback.
work: Integrated industrial sensors with real welding equipment to connect physical torch movement to virtual welding exercises.
Calibrated sensing and reviewed hand straightness, torch position and travel speed as operator performance measures.
Supported 3D model preparation, room setup and VR training sessions for manufacturing teams in India and Morocco.
Tested simulation stability and latency, documented interface issues and coordinated technical improvements with vendor engineers.
Developed an offline multilingual translator to support communication with international delegates.
projects.context: The training system gives operators repeatable practice and immediate performance feedback. The simulated weld strength score is a training metric, rather than a physical weld qualification test.

projects.title: Tata Advanced Systems Ltd · LMD AI Driven Digital Transformation
projects.org: Tata Advanced Systems · Land Mobility Division
projects.summary: AI and LLM applications, enterprise workflow automation, XR/VR deployment and renewable energy commissioning.
projects.overview: In my second internship at Tata Advanced Systems, Land Mobility Division, I supported AI driven digital transformation and automation initiatives across manufacturing training and enterprise workflows.
work: Contributed to AI and LLM application development and optimisation for enterprise productivity.
Developed workflow automation solutions and prepared technical documentation and Standard Operating Procedures.
Assisted with XR/VR training system deployment, testing and technical support.
Participated in renewable energy system installation and commissioning.
Coordinated technical requirements and issue resolution with cross functional teams and external vendors.
Contributed to digital literacy and sustainability initiatives through the company CSR programme.
projects.context: This internship extended my work from immersive operator training into digital operations, application development and practical implementation.

projects.title: Punch MY24 · Manufacturing Launch & Quality
projects.summary: New model introduction, proving plans, manufacturing readiness and cross functional quality coordination.
projects.overview: During the Punch MY24 launch at Tata Motors Passenger Vehicle Limited, I supported new model introduction and operational quality. My work connected proving activities, component readiness, vehicle tracking and quality data.
work: Managed Vendor Quality Assurance data and supported PPAP compliance.
Prepared proving plans and reviewed rollup data for more than 35 BIW variants.
Used SAP for project data and IPMS for vehicle status tracking.
Supported readiness checks across Press/BIW, facilities, software, logistics and VQA.
Collaborated with TS, CPA, VQA, craftsmanship and logistics teams.
Supported component fitment checks, prismatic battery bolt inspection, brake tube interference follow up and ECU flashing activities.
Reviewed manufacturing information through BOM data, part genealogy and station readiness records.
projects.context: The Punch MY24 launch required component, process and vehicle data to stay aligned across manufacturing stages. I worked with BIW proving and variant rollup data, PPAP and VQA records, SAP part information and IPMS vehicle tracking. Station readiness checks, BOM and part genealogy reviews, component fitment inspections and ECU flashing activities connected launch planning with practical quality validation on the production line.

projects.title: Transdermal Drug Delivery · Device Development
projects.summary: Sonophoresis, iontophoresis and rapidly prototyped microneedle moulds for transdermal drug delivery.
projects.overview: At IIT Bombay, I contributed to medical device development for transdermal drug delivery. My work covered electronic circuits, transducer integration, experimental validation and the design of microneedle moulds.
work: Designed circuit schematics and PCB layouts in KiCad for a sonophoresis drug delivery prototype.
Integrated ultrasound transducers and driver circuitry, with temperature monitoring during module testing.
Supported experimental work on porcine skin and recorded prototype observations for iterative development.
Contributed to controlled current circuitry for iontophoresis based transdermal delivery.
Designed microneedle moulds in Fusion 360 and supported fabrication through 3D printing.
projects.context: At NanoBios Lab, Department of Biosciences and Bioengineering, under Prof. Rohit Srivastava, I connected electronics development with experimental drug delivery research. Sonophoresis work involved KiCad circuit and PCB design, ultrasound driver integration and temperature monitoring during prototype testing. Iontophoresis work focused on controlled current circuitry, while the microneedle project used Fusion 360 and 3D printing to develop and refine mould geometry. Module testing and observations from porcine skin experiments informed subsequent prototype iterations.

projects.title: Automated Guided Vehicle Planning & Factory Automation
projects.summary: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) route planning, machine design and industrial safety systems.
projects.overview: At Haldiram Foods International in Nagpur, I worked on Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) route planning and automation concepts, alongside practical exposure to maintenance and troubleshooting. The work connected automated material movement, machine design and an automated emergency response system with the requirements of a working factory.
work: Developed an Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) layout for raw material transport, considering worker movement, machinery, safety zones and production routes.
Designed an automatic pistachio cleaning machine.
Developed an IoT based emergency response system for automatic fire exit unlocking and alerts.
Supported maintenance and troubleshooting of existing machinery.
projects.context: Planning automation around workers, machinery, safety zones and production flow helped me understand the factory as a connected system.

projects.title: AeroMind · Autonomous Multi Payload UAV
projects.imageAlt: AeroMind modular UAV prototype with payload mounting and operator
projects.summary: An autonomous modular aerial system for medical logistics, surveillance and disaster response.
projects.overview: AeroMind is an autonomous modular multi payload aerial system with adaptive AI control architecture. The final year project explored how one aerial platform could support medical logistics, surveillance and disaster response applications.
work: Integrated autonomous flight, AI perception and embedded control into the aerial system architecture.
Developed the modular payload arrangement for medical logistics, surveillance and disaster response use cases.
Evaluated payload mass, mounting constraints and airframe integration during prototype iterations.
Tested thermal imaging and person detection for surveillance, including aerial thermal capture and ground based RGB and thermal validation.
projects.context: Utility Patent Application No. 202621059159 is published. Related research was presented at CVR 2026, NIT Goa, with proceedings forthcoming in Springer.

projects.title: Smart Mobility Aid · Navigation & Emergency Response
projects.summary: Obstacle detection, haptic feedback and location aware emergency assistance for the visually impaired.
projects.overview: This smart mobility aid combines obstacle detection, fall detection and emergency communication to support people with visual impairments. The project joins embedded electronics and sensor feedback with practical assistive device design.
work: Integrated ultrasonic sensors and haptic feedback for obstacle detection.
Used Arduino and Raspberry Pi for control and supporting functions.
Integrated a GPS/GSM module for live tracking and distress alerts.
Used piezoelectric sensors for fall detection and a camera for emergency image capture.
projects.context: Utility Patent Application No. 202421073593. Granted Design No. 436426-001. Copyright application for Smart Mobility Aid with AI powered Navigation and Emergency Assistance for the Visually Impaired.

projects.title: FDM 3D Printer · Connected Rapid Prototyping
projects.summary: A 3D printer built from scratch with LAN connectivity and filament monitoring.
projects.overview: I designed and fabricated a functional FDM 3D printer from scratch. The project combined mechanical construction, electronics, printer configuration and monitoring features.
work: Built and configured the FDM printer.
Integrated LAN connectivity for remote operation.
Added filament monitoring sensors to reduce material waste during failed prints.
projects.context: The project developed practical skills in mechanical assembly, embedded electronics and additive manufacturing.

projects.title: Automated Assembly Line · PLC Integration
projects.summary: Siemens S7-300 process control with sensors, actuators and real time monitoring.
projects.overview: I customised and integrated an automated assembly line system using a Siemens S7-300 PLC. The work focused on process control, equipment sequencing and feedback from industrial sensors.
work: Configured Siemens S7 300 PLC hardware and developed ladder logic in TIA Portal.
Mapped sensor inputs and actuator outputs to the PLC I/O for equipment sequencing.
Integrated sensors and actuators into the assembly process and checked the control sequence during operation.
projects.context: This project turned classroom knowledge of PLCs and automation into an integrated control system.

projects.title: Chemical Mixing · HMI Process Control
projects.summary: A Siemens PLC controlled mixing process with custom HMI screens and live process tags.
projects.overview: This project automated a chemical mixing process through a Siemens PLC and an HMI. I developed control logic and operator screens around the process requirements.
work: Developed ladder logic in TIA Portal for the chemical mixing sequence.
Configured PLC and HMI tags to connect process states with operator controls.
Designed operator screens for monitoring and controlling the mixing process.
Checked live tag updates and operator command responses during system integration.
projects.context: The project connected control programming with the way operators monitor and interact with a process.

projects.title: Robotic Hand · Gesture Based Control
projects.summary: A robotic hand that mirrors human finger movement through flex sensor input.
projects.overview: I developed a robotic hand controlled by flex sensors. The project translated human finger movement into commands for the robotic mechanism.
work: Calibrated flex sensor readings against finger bending to establish the usable input range.
Mapped sensor values to servo commands for individual finger movement.
Integrated sensing, embedded control and mechanical actuation into the robotic hand.
projects.context: The prototype combined sensor calibration, embedded control and mechanical movement.

projects.title: PET Filament · Sustainable 3D Printing
projects.summary: A heated extrusion system that converts plastic bottle ribbons into 3D printer filament.
projects.overview: I developed a PET filament machine to reuse plastic bottles as feedstock for 3D printing. The machine processes bottle ribbons through a heated nozzle to create filament.
work: Designed a heated nozzle system for PET bottle ribbons.
Developed the mechanical feed and extrusion arrangement.
Worked toward uniform filament for printing applications.
projects.context: The project explored a practical connection between material reuse and additive manufacturing.

leadership.body: Managed placement activities for the Mechatronics department, coordinating students, faculty and company representatives. Handled communication, scheduling and departmental follow up, using clear communication to support employer engagement and a smooth recruitment process.

btech.body: Automation, Robotics, Embedded Electronics, Application and Device Development formed the core of my undergraduate studies. Academic projects and industrial internships helped me apply this foundation to control systems, medical devices, smart manufacturing and autonomous systems.
